title: dmri_paths
description: Tool for diffusion MRI path analysis.

indir.description: Input subject directory (optional), specify multiple for longitudinal data.
indir.title: Input Subject Directory

ntr.description: Max number of tracts per voxel (default 1).
ntr.title: Max Number of Tracts per Voxel

basereg.description: Base-to-DWI registration, needed for longitudinal data only (.mat, as many as input directories).
basereg.title: Base-to-DWI Registration

roi1.description: End ROI 1 (volume or label, one per path).
roi1.title: End ROI 1

roi2.description: End ROI 2 (volume or label, one per path).
roi2.title: End ROI 2

roimesh1.description: Mesh for end ROI 1 (for label ROIs).
roimesh1.title: Mesh for End ROI 1

roimesh2.description: Mesh for end ROI 2 (for label ROIs).
roimesh2.title: Mesh for End ROI 2

roiref1.description: Reference volume for end ROI 1 (for label ROIs).
roiref1.title: Reference Volume for End ROI 1

roiref2.description: Reference volume for end ROI 2 (for label ROIs).
roiref2.title: Reference Volume for End ROI 2

prior.description: Spatial path priors (negative log-likelihoods off and on the path, one pair per path).
prior.title: Spatial Path Priors

nprior.description: Near-neighbor label priors (negative log-likelihood and list of labels, one pair per path).
nprior.title: Near-neighbor Label Priors

nset.description: Subset of near-neighbor label priors (default all).
nset.title: Subset of Near-neighbor Label Priors

lprior.description: Local-neighbor label priors (negative log-likelihood and list of labels, one pair per path).
lprior.title: Local-neighbor Label Priors

lset.description: Subset of local-neighbor label priors (default all).
lset.title: Subset of Local-neighbor Label Priors

seg.description: Segmentation map of test subject, specify multiple for longitudinal data.
seg.title: Segmentation Map

tprior.description: Path tangent vector priors (negative log-likelihood, one per path).
tprior.title: Path Tangent Vector Priors

cprior.description: Path curvature priors (negative log-likelihood, one per path).
cprior.title: Path Curvature Priors

init.description: Text file of initial control points (one per path).
init.title: Initial Control Points

sdp.description: Text file with initial proposal standard deviations for control point perturbations.
sdp.title: Initial Proposal SDs

checkopts.description: Don't run anything, just check options and exit.
checkopts.title: Check Options
